claim: For every K4-free graph the triangle cover number (least number of triangle-free subgraphs covering the edges) is at most the triangle-free chromatic ceiling (the supremum of chromatic numbers of triangle-free subgraphs); and more generally, for any linear order on the vertices, the triangle cover number is at most the supremum over vertices of the chromatic number of the subgraph induced on the neighbours lying above that vertex, which yields that every graph on kappa-plus vertices is a union of kappa triangle-free subgraphs.
